acquisition.correlation: Joint native/blurred observation model or conditional native likelihood given observed blurred outcome; never multiply marginal likelihoods as independent and never call evidence replacement an exact joint posterior.
acquisition.count_proxy: Any observable component/score feature is a prediction feature, not the evaluator building UID or a claimed true instance count.
acquisition.implementation_status: Six-scene paired/count search engineering complete. Boundary-only cross-cell discount failed and is not selected. Full 72-scene fitting, exact global distinct-building utility, existence ablation and strong baselines remain incomplete.
acquisition.utility: Expected incremental distinct-building discovery proxy / action cost, fitted on development; existence-only utility retained as an explicit ablation.

adapter_source.role: Alternative image/polygon representation only; cohort membership still audited against author hold.

admission_gates: Repackaged hold names map to audited author hold; individual source polygons retained; original UID or explicitly derived per-source-object identity is traceable and duplicate-safe.
RGB shape/orientation and canonical pixel hashes match overlapping original examples; masks/unknown semantics checked on development probes only.
Audit exact image duplicates and available geographic overlap across policy splits, and disclose detector-training adjacency separately. Unavailable scene footprints are recorded as unverified.

No damage outcomes determine cohort membership. At least three target-bearing confirmation events are required for a three-event positive replication claim; otherwise restrict conclusions and do not swap samples.
Measurement and count/correlation baseline implementation gates complete before validation/confirmation policy scoring.

comparisons.fairness: Same allowed observations, action eligibility, costs, quality maps and fitting data; report actual upgrades and planning wall time.
comparisons.new_method: NONE_SELECTED; local residual propagation and short-prefix switching are previous exploratory candidates, not established contributions.
comparisons.required_literature: Specify a budget-compatible ENS/MF-ENS or rollout adaptation before any new-method claim; do not present an adaptation as a faithful reproduction without verification.
required_simple: development-fitted count-greedy with correlated upgrade likelihood

decision_rule.current: No new controller training or paid GPU until data and measurement admission passes.
decision_rule.failure: Report failure and stop adding parameters to that candidate; a changed hypothesis requires a new version and unconsumed confirmation evidence.
decision_rule.statistics: Average repeated seeds within scenes first; report paired scene effects and separate events/spatial groups. Three events do not justify precise population-level confidence or treating seeds/cells as independent disasters.
decision_rule.validation_go: For a later prespecified candidate: >=10% relative primary gain over each required simple baseline, >=0.1 additional building/scene in event-macro mean, positive gains in >=2/3 target-bearing validation events, and <=0.05 extra false-positive cells/scene. These are engineering effect-size targets, not significance tests.
decision_rule.zero_baseline: If a baseline primary mean is zero, do not report relative percentage gain; apply the absolute-gain and event/false-positive conditions and report the zero denominator.

measurement.legacy_discovery_proxy: raster_visibility_v2: >=4 overlapping severe pixels and >=10% visible-footprint coverage; explicit proxy, not verified real-world identification.
measurement.primary: For each event average distinct discovered buildings per scene, then average events equally at budget 32, mixed quality, native-upgrade cost 2.
measurement.required_measurement_gate: Before policy scores, inspect the six development interface probes for UID, polygons, alignment and boundary behavior; re-score all fixed trajectories at 5/10/25% coverage. A changed measurement definition requires a new version before validation/confirmation outcomes.
secondary: Event-wise and scene-wise building recall; no-target recall null
Known-negative false-positive cells and unmatched positives
Discovery-versus-cost curve and censored first-discovery cost
Raw counts and event target composition; no target-free event counted as a positive replication
measurement.unit: Original UID when available; otherwise (pinned_source_revision, sample_id, source_object_index) with polygon fingerprint. Clearly mark as derived identity, never claim original UID recovered. Verify duplicates and object/class ordering before admission; no mask connected-component substitution.

objective: Maximize expected NEW distinct major-damage/destroyed building discoveries under an observation budget; engineering image-search proxy.

observations.cost_limits: Declared observation costs only. No inference of actual flight/energy savings. No new UAV viewpoint or genuine recovery of lost image information.
observations.grid: 64 non-overlapping 128x128 cells in a 1024x1024 image; coarse RGB prior available initially; truth private.
observations.positive_cells: No blanket positive-cell terminal rule before the eligible native upgrade; expected additional building reward may be nonzero.
observations.sensor: Existing pinned ChangeOS model and frozen image preprocessing; no retraining in this stage.
observations.survey: Cost 1; fixed hidden quality assignment per cell; future actual quality unavailable to planner.
observations.upgrade: One native observation after any blurred survey, including a blurred positive. Upgrade is not an independent image. No repeated native action.

preservation: All mini72 observations, fits, protocols, reports and failed variants remain unchanged.
research_questions: Does the coarse image prior retain discovery value over coverage across new hold images and multiple events?
What share of benefit is due to coverage/ranking versus the offered native upgrade, and is it robust to its declared cost?
After count-objective alignment and correlated likelihoods, is there enough remaining gain to justify a new adaptive mechanism?

sampling.annotation_access_after_this_design_free: Trusted extractor may transiently decode the shared damage column but return only the exact allowlist. No other damage values/class statistics/model outputs/policy scores may be returned. Never persist shared damage payloads. Prior physical access to shared reserved payloads is disclosed.

excluded_event.guatemala-volcano: Only five hold identities; excluded before outcomes to keep equal 24-scene event cohorts.

sampling.interface_probes: First two selected IDs in each development event only (six total). No confirmation damage payload access during admission.
sampling.no_replacement: Missing files, invalid annotations, target sparsity or failed admission never trigger automatic swaps or outcome-based expansion.

split_meaning.confirmation: Florence/Matthew/Palu have not been used in mini72 policy experiments; use only after complete baseline/method lock.
split_meaning.development: All sensor/prior/count-utility fitting, interface QA and mechanism exploration; overlaps previously explored event types.
split_meaning.perception: All nine events occur in the frozen detector training pool. ID-disjoint hold cannot establish unseen-event perception generalization.
split_meaning.validation: One prespecified baseline screening run after implementations are frozen; prior Michael event exploration is disclosed.
